# User guide

## Open the review

Open the published review at <https://claycobusinesssolutions.github.io/Clayco-Homepage/> (`README.md:5`). The root page redirects to the review interface (`index.html:5-8`). The package is a design review, not the production Clayco website.

## Compare designs and motion

1. Open **Design & motion controls** if the control panel is closed.
2. Select one of the five designs: Tweaked original or New version (Sam Alcarez), Homepage redesign (Sam Bromley), Task-first or Gallery (Dohyoung Kim) (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:22-30`).
3. Use **Original**, **A Block**, **B Swipe**, or **C Linear** to apply a motion family. Use **Pause** or **Replay** to control the preview (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:33-36`).
4. Open **Motion settings** to select a treatment per section, save or load a motion set, or copy a link that carries the current design and motion mix (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:38-42`).
5. Use **Jump to** to navigate to an available section, **Open design** for a separate page, or **Full screen** for presentation (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:44-48`).
6. Use the device buttons to switch between desktop and the iPhone 18 Pro preview (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:51-54`).

Saved motion sets are kept in the current browser only, not synced between users or devices (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:40`, `Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:32-33`). Copy a review link to share the current design/mix rather than expecting a saved set to transfer (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:42-48`).

## Troubleshooting

- **The comparison controls do not work:** enable JavaScript. The page provides direct prototype links when JavaScript is unavailable (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:70`).
- **A preview did not open:** choose **Reload design** or **Open design** (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:65-66`).
- **A saved set did not persist:** browser storage may be disabled or unavailable. The review displays a warning and recommends copying the review link instead (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:109`).
- **A public link or video is unavailable offline:** some prototype links and videos require an internet connection (`README.txt:11-12`).
- **The control panel is hidden:** use the sliders button; it controls whether the review controls are shown (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:14-18`).

For an offline copy, `README.txt` instructs users to open `Open Clayco Review.html` and keep the package folder together (`README.txt:4-9`).
